title: regression-testing guide (docs): the setup wizard only wires up tracing; MLflow skills and eval code come from a separate skills install
answers: Does the MLflow setup wizard install the MLflow skills into my coding agent?
Where do I get the MLflow skills for Claude Code or Codex?
Why doesn't the regression testing setup step write my evaluation or pytest code?
body:
Path: docs/docs/genai/eval-monitor/regression-testing.mdx: the 'Set up' step card, the coding-agent tip, and the 'MLflow skills for coding agents' link card. Together they cover running the hosted setup wizard to connect to MLflow and launch a coding agent for tracing, and the separate path for writing regression tests with pytest and @mlflow.test.
Rule: The hosted wizard (`curl -LsSf https://mlflow.org/wizard/setup.sh | sh`) connects to MLflow and launches the agent to add tracing. It does not install MLflow skills and does not write evaluation code. Skills are installed separately using the instructions at https://github.com/mlflow/skills#installation. Docs must not say the wizard installs skills or writes regression tests; state the split explicitly and link the skills instructions.
Symptom: Readers following the guide expected one command to install skills and write regression tests, which the wizard does not do.
Constraints: Applies to regression-testing and similar eval/monitor onboarding copy. The tracing-only quickstart and README do not need the skills caveat. Does not change the `mlflow agent setup` CLI behaviour.
applies: Docs copy in the eval/monitor regression-testing guide that describes what the setup wizard or skills installation does.
says: The setup wizard connected tracing but did not install coding agent skills.
Why did running the onboarding script not generate my evaluation test code?
The regression testing guide mistakenly suggests one command configures both tracing and skills.
Clarify in documentation that agent skills require a separate manual installation step.
Where can I find instructions to add assistant skills for regression testing?
search: Documentation in docs/docs/genai/eval-monitor/regression-testing.mdx must state that the hosted setup wizard (curl -LsSf https://mlflow.org/wizard/setup.sh | sh) only configures MLflow tracing and does not install MLflow skills or generate evaluation code. The guide must explicitly direct users to install skills separately via https://github.com/mlflow/skills#installation rather than claiming the wizard handles skills or regression test creation. This rule applies specifically to regression testing and eval/monitor onboarding copy, without affecting the tracing quickstart, README, or the mlflow agent setup CLI.
